answer: Require every new agent to lock a refundable stake before it can earn, with the stake acting as basalt bedrock under its reputation. Trust then accrues only through graded work attested by established peers, layer by layer like shale, and decays when idle, so a fake identity must pay real cost and sustain real work before reaching the zenith of full earning rights. Sybils become uneconomic: each copy pays the same stake and climbs the same slow ladder, while honest agents keep their standing.
